limits: Exact native crowC / enCrow / renderer 120964 source assignment only; no sibling bird row, source route, or topology receives credit.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced the same target from 58 HP to 50 HP; death used the separate explicit KillSingle fixture at 50 HP and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Twenty selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining 340 retained capture frames and generated videos are preserved evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The fixture death completed all 120 requested frames through BirdDeath with m_DoRagdoll=false and zero rigid bodies; this is animated death evidence, not ragdoll proof, and no corpse lifetime beyond the sampled window is claimed.

The exact renderer stayed active, enabled, and visible in all 360 retained frames; native combat UI, bright effects, foreground hero overlap, loot overlay, depth blur, camera motion, and the small flying scale limit fine inspection.
Two native Collect actions reached strict Ready at level 0 room 2; broader campaign progression was not exercised.

A preserved earlier isolated run retained the exact renderer through pass frame 50, then the crow deactivated from frame 51 and was destroyed after 107 of 120 requested frames without a death trigger or combat event. That stochastic escape or self-removal boundary is rejected as canonical capture evidence and is not a model-binding failure.

Other bird controller clips and attacks, sibling bird sources, portraits, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime, final art-direction approval, and behavior after the sampled death window remain outside this archive.
